arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the side that brought the case's advocate stated that the Michigan Court of Appeals erred in creating an end-run around Strickland.
the side that brought the case's advocate argued that a defendant's professed innocence does not automatically prove effective assistance.
the opposing side's advocate noted that the lower court found the submitted materials sufficient to justify a hearing.
Justice Kagan questioned the lower court's reasoning regarding a defendant's refusal to plead guilty.
